title: perfratio --export-json output
description: Schema of the JSON export, schemaVersion 1.36 (docs/specs/output-schema-contract.md). Unknown keys are allowed, as the contract requires of consumers; the repository test validates against a strict copy so that a field missing here fails CI. Regenerate by hand together with SCHEMA_VERSION.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR of the contract; first key of the document.

interrupted.description: Only present (true) when Ctrl-C stopped the run.

optimize.description: Present with --optimize: one object, or an array with one entry per search.

complexity.description: Present with --complexity: one empirical growth-model fit per command template (docs/specs/complexity-fit.md).

status.description: Status of one measurement group. Open enum: consumers must tolerate unknown values.

summary.description: Mean, sample standard deviation (omitted with one value), median and range.

outlierStats.description: Outliers of one series and the fences outside of which a value counts as one.

energy_unavailable_reason.description: Why energy is unavailable. Open enum: unsupported_platform, rapl_not_found, rapl_unreadable, unsupported_cpu, ioreport_not_found, ioreport_frozen, emi_not_found, emi_unreadable, other.

counters.description: `measured`, `partial` (some events could not be opened), `unavailable` or `not_requested`.

counters_unavailable_reason.description: Open enum: unsupported_platform, perf_paranoid, no_pmu, kernel_scope_denied, other.

counters_unavailable_events.description: Event keys that could not be opened (status partial), suffixed ones read e.g. `instructions:k`.

counters_requested_scope.description: Scope that was asked for when it differs from `counters_scope` (e.g. `all` next to `user`).

topdown_unavailable_reason.description: Open enum: unsupported_platform, unsupported_cpu, unsupported_kernel, perf_paranoid, no_pmu, hybrid_cpu_unpinned, other.

simd_unavailable_reason.description: Open enum: unsupported_platform, unsupported_cpu, perf_paranoid, no_pmu, hybrid_cpu_unpinned, other.

region.description: `--region` (1.23): `measured` when requested, otherwise `not_requested`. A run that did not report a region shows as null in `results[].regions[]`.

measurements.description: Host-level status per measurement group, identical for every result.

command_line.description: argv; the program is reduced to its file name.

started_at.description: Start of the run, RFC 3339 UTC, second precision.

system.description: No hostname or user name is exported, by design.

energy_backend.description: Backend that produced the energy samples. Open enum: sysfs_powercap, perf_pmu, ioreport, windows_emi.

region_protocol.description: Region protocol version perfratio speaks (1.23). Present only with --region or --metric region:<name>.

jobs.description: Runs executing at the same time (--jobs N, N > 1).

contended.description: The runs disturbed each other; always true.

reserved.description: CPUs kept for perfratio's own threads; no worker uses them. Omitted when none.

shared_siblings.description: More workers than physical cores: some workers share a core with another worker. Omitted when false.

cpu_partition.description: Only when the workers were pinned (--pin-workers=auto, the default with --jobs > 1 on Linux and Windows). New in 1.24, #307.

metrics.description: Descriptor of every metric of this export, generated from one registry (new in 1.20, #317). A metric that could not be measured keeps its descriptor with a `status` other than `available` and has no values in `results`; it is never written as 0. `status`, `reason`, `kind`, `scope` and `direction` are open enums.

governor.description: cpufreq governor; 'mixed' when the CPUs differ.

container.description: Present when a container was detected.

environment.description: Hardware and software the benchmarks ran on (new in 1.22, #314). A field the platform cannot report is omitted. No host name, user name, environment variables or working directory.

environment_fingerprint.description: Hash over cpu_model, arch, os_family, kernel_major, governor, smt and container (docs/specs/environment-fingerprint.md).

wall_floor.description: Median wall time of a trivial command, net of the shell spawn time, in seconds.

wall_floor_mad.description: Median absolute deviation of the calibration wall times.

rss_floor.description: Median peak RSS of the trivial command in bytes. Omitted when the platform reports none.

calibration.description: Runner floor measured by --calibrate (new in 1.27, #313). Omitted with --calibrate=off, with --debug-mode, or when it could not be measured.

estimator.description: mean, median or a percentile such as p95: the central value behind relative_speed, significance and the comparisons.

bootstrap_seed.description: Unsigned 64-bit; may exceed 2^53, so read it as an integer, not a double.

noise_threshold.description: New in 1.36 (#323): --noise-threshold as a fraction (0.05 = 5%). Present only when set.

equivalence_margin.description: New in 1.36 (#323): --equivalence-margin as a fraction. Present only when set.

correction.description: New in 1.32 (#321): the multiple-comparison correction behind p_value_adjusted and significance. Present only with --correction other than none.

family_size.description: Number of comparisons with a defined p-value in the family.

statistics.description: New in 1.21 (#320): how the ranking, ratios, intervals and significance were computed. Always written by 1.21 and later; not required here, so that a MINOR addition is not a breaking change for consumers of older exports.

mode.description: grouped, round-robin, randomized, balanced, or with --jobs saturate, exclusive, fair. Open enum.

seed.description: Unsigned 64-bit seed of the shuffled order; only with mode randomized (the --seed value).

order.description: Realized order of the measured runs of an interleaved schedule: the results[] index of each run, in execution order. Omitted for grouped, with --jobs and with a single command.

schedule.description: New in 1.25 (#324): how the runs of several commands were ordered. Always written by 1.25 and later; not required here, so that a MINOR addition is not a breaking change for consumers of older exports.

baseline.description: Path of the --compare baseline; absent for absolute budgets without a baseline.

verdict.description: pass, fail, or not_evaluated (no budget could be evaluated). Open enum.

metric.description: The metric with its statistic as written, e.g. wall, memory, wall.p95, throughput.

limit.description: Relative: a fraction of the baseline (0.05 = +5%). Absolute: seconds, bytes, joules or a count.

baseline.description: Value in the baseline; omitted when unavailable, never 0.

current.description: Value of this run; omitted when unavailable, never 0.

p_value.description: p-value of the difference of the per-run samples, when it was computed.

verdict.description: pass, fail, within_noise or not_evaluated. Open enum.

reason.description: Why the budget is not_evaluated: unavailable_in_baseline, unavailable_in_current, baseline_not_positive, too_few_runs. Open enum.

compare.description: New in 1.29 (#325): the outcome of --budget and --fail-if-regressed. Not required here, so that a MINOR addition is not a breaking change for consumers of older exports.

metadata.description: Run metadata. `environment` and `environment_fingerprint` (new in 1.28, #314) are always written by 1.28 and later; not required here, so that a MINOR addition is not a breaking change for consumers of older exports.

metric.description: Metric used for ranking. The built-in set is closed; `custom:<name>` is a pattern (unit and direction in `perfratio.metrics[]`, from 1.30; unitless and lower is better if undeclared); `region:<name>` ranks on the time inside an instrumented region (seconds, lower is better, 1.21).

primaryMetric.description: Statistics of the ranking metric (only with --metric other than wall).

percentiles.description: Percentiles of the run times in seconds.

firstRun.description: Cold first run reported separately with --first-run=separate; not part of any other field.

diagnostics.description: Interference diagnostics of the run times.

outliers.description: Outliers of the run times (flattened) and, when measured, memory (bytes) and energy (J).

resources.description: Per-run OS counters aligned with `times`. A column the OS cannot report is omitted.

efficiency.description: Derived counter metrics; rates are fractions.

stopping_rule.description: New in 1.26 (#322): fixed_ci or confidence_sequence (--target-precision-method). Open enum.

achieved_half_width.description: New in 1.26 (#322): half-width of the stopping rule's interval, relative to the mean; the same value as reached.

baseline.description: --subtract: the baseline whose mean was subtracted from every run.

instancePercentiles.description: Percentiles over all runs x N instance times.

validation.description: Output validation (--expect-output-sha256, --validate). runs_invalid > 0 means the workload did not produce the expected result.

id.description: Open enum: ignore ids you do not know.

below_resolution.description: The mean is within the runner floor (new in 1.27, #313). Omitted when no floor was measured.

quality.description: Measurement quality report. grade: any fail -> unreliable, else any warn -> with_caveats, else comparable.

stddev.description: Sample standard deviation in seconds; null with fewer than 2 runs.

times.description: Wall time per run in seconds. With `concurrency`, the makespan of each run.

memory_usage_byte.description: Peak RSS per run in bytes; maximum of any instance with `concurrency`.

exit_codes.description: Exit code per run (null: killed by a signal). With `concurrency`, N entries per run, row-major.

relative_speed.description: Ratio to the fastest result or the reference (1.0 = baseline).

relative_speed_ci.description: New in 1.21 (#320): [low, high] bootstrap interval of relative_speed at statistics.confidence_level, for estimators other than the mean.

significance.description: Difference to the reference; omitted for the reference and when the test is undefined.

p_value.description: p-value of the bootstrap Welch test against the reference.

effect.description: New in 1.36 (#323): the change relative to the reference with its interval at statistics.confidence_level. Present only with --noise-threshold or --equivalence-margin, and when the comparison has per-run times.

relative_change.description: other / reference - 1 of the estimator (0.05 = 5% slower).

cohens_d.description: Difference of the means over the pooled standard deviation; positive: slower than the reference.

common_language.description: Probability that a run is slower than a run of the reference, ties counting half (Mann-Whitney U / (n m)).

minimum_detectable_effect.description: Smallest relative change detected with 80% power at the current runs and variance.

runs_needed.description: Runs per command for the equivalence test to succeed with 80% power; only for an inconclusive result.

classification.description: New in 1.36 (#323): closed enum; present together with effect.

equivalence_p_value.description: New in 1.36 (#323): p-value of the equivalence test (TOST); only with --equivalence-margin and the mean estimator.

p_value_adjusted.description: New in 1.32 (#321): p_value after statistics.correction; significance is decided on this value. Omitted without a correction.

energy_joules.description: Energy per run in joules; only when every run has a sample.

energy_samples.description: Runs that produced an energy sample, whenever an energy sampler was active. Below the run count means partial coverage.

energy_domains_joules.description: Joules per RAPL domain and run (keys package, core, uncore, dram, psys). Domains overlap and are not additive.

custom_metrics.description: Values extracted with --output-metric, one per run; null where not extracted.

discarded_outliers.description: Zero-based indices of runs excluded by --discard-outliers.

counters.description: Raw counts per run aligned with `times`; null = not readable. Keys are event names (hardware events, and the software events cpu-migrations, context-switches, page-faults, task-clock in ns), optionally suffixed :u or :k.

counters_coverage.description: Lowest time_running / time_enabled (0..1) over the runs, only for events that were multiplexed or never scheduled.

counters_scope.description: Effective scope of unsuffixed counter keys: all, user or kernel.

effective_frequency_hz.description: Effective CPU frequency of each run in Hz (cycles / time on CPU), aligned with `times`; null where it could not be computed.

mean_effective_frequency_hz.description: Mean of `effective_frequency_hz` over the runs with at least 5 ms on CPU.

effective_frequency_basis.description: Time that divides `cycles`. Open enum: task_clock, user_time, system_time.

topdown.description: Top-down level 1 (--topdown): per-run fractions of all issue slots aligned with `times`; null = run not measured. A hypothesis about the stall class, not a diagnosis.

bottleneck.description: Largest non-retiring class. Open enum: backend_bound, frontend_bound, bad_speculation, smt_contention.

concurrency.description: Instances per run (--concurrency N, N > 1). Changes the meaning of `times` and `exit_codes`.

energy_per_instance_joules.description: No longer written since 1.19: package energy is not divided per instance.

energy_scope.description: Scope of the energy values (1.19): `system` (package counter, covers the whole machine) or `batch` (--concurrency: energy of the whole batch over the makespan).

run_ids.description: PERFRATIO_RUN_ID of every run in `times` (1.19). With --concurrency: the id of instance 0.

instance_run_ids.description: --concurrency: PERFRATIO_RUN_ID of every instance, one row per run aligned with `instance_times`; the position in the row is PERFRATIO_WORKER_ID (1.19).

leftover_processes.description: Only present when true (1.19): processes started by the command outlived it in at least one run and were killed.

regions.description: `--region` (1.23): time inside each instrumented region. `mean`, `times` and the other time fields keep measuring the whole process.

workers_used.description: Workers that executed at least one timed run (--jobs N, N > 1; new in 1.22).

contended.description: Runs were executed in parallel (--jobs N, N > 1) and may have disturbed each other; do not compare with sequential samples (new in 1.22).

simd.description: Per-run floating-point breakdown (`--simd`) aligned with `times`; null = not readable. A bucket the CPU lacks is absent.

simd_summary.description: Summary of every SIMD bucket and of `vectorization_ratio`.

simd_scope.description: Scope counted for `simd`: all, user or kernel.

simd_scaling.description: Buckets scaled for multiplexing: runs and lowest coverage.

cgroup_throttled_usec.description: Microseconds the cgroup was throttled by its CPU quota during the runs (the cgroup's counter). Omitted when unreadable.

cgroup_throttled_runs.description: Runs during which the throttled time grew.

cgroup_oom_kills.description: Processes killed by the OOM killer in the cgroup during the runs.

throttle_events.description: Thermal throttling events the CPUs reported; omitted when no counter exists.

thermal.description: Hottest CPU temperature sensor in degrees Celsius.

interference.description: Environment observed while the runs executed (new in 1.31, #315). A source that cannot be read is omitted, never 0.

status.description: `region_missing`: some runs did not report the region (null entries, left out of the statistics). A region no run reported is an error, never exported.

stddev.description: null with a single reporting run.

count_per_run.description: Start/stop pairs summed into each run's time; null where the run did not report the region.

times.description: Seconds inside the region per run, aligned with `results[].times`; null = not reported, never 0.

sdk.description: Identifier the SDK announced in its hello line.

metrics.description: New in 1.33 (#371): `--region-scope` only. CPU time, energy and counters inside the region, read when the SDK reported the markers (docs/specs/region-scope.md). Omitted without the flag.

region.description: Time inside one instrumented region, in seconds (see docs/specs/region-protocol.md).

name.description: `cpu_user`, `cpu_system`, `energy` or a counter name such as `instructions`.

scope.description: Always `region`. The whole-process values under `results[]` stay unchanged.

values.description: Per run, aligned with `results[].times`; null = could not be read, never 0.

region_metric.description: One value measured inside a region (new in 1.33, #371), summed over the region's start/stop pairs of a run.

reevaluated.description: Values run a second time by --optimize-confirm (1.15).

metric.description: Metric with optional statistic, e.g. wall or wall.p95.

noise_threshold.description: Relative threshold of --noise-threshold (0.05 = 5%); absent for strict comparison.

within_noise.description: Frontier members strictly dominated within the noise threshold.

unit.description: `s`, `bytes`, `J`, `W`, `Hz`, `count`, `ns`, `ratio`, `percent`, `runs/s` or `unitless` (custom metrics, or the unit declared with `--output-metric NAME[unit,higher]=REGEX`, 1.30).

source.description: Where the value comes from, e.g. `perfratio.timer`, `os.rusage`, `linux.perf_event_open`, `sysfs_powercap`, `command_output`.

reason.description: Why the status is not `available` (same tokens as `perfratio.measurements.*_unavailable_reason`).

fields.description: Keys of `results[]` that hold the values.

command.description: The command with {VAR} in place of the value.

metrics.description: Keyed by wall, memory, energy, instructions.
